title: Ethical Hacking & VAPT
tagline: Think Like an Attacker. Secure Like a Defender.
description: Master the fundamentals of Ethical Hacking and Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT). Learn how security professionals discover, assess, validate, and report security vulnerabilities through interactive lessons, visual explanations, quizzes, AI tutoring, and practical labs.
learningObjectives: Understand ethical hacking methodology and the VAPT lifecycle
Perform reconnaissance and information gathering using OSINT techniques
Conduct footprinting and network scanning to map attack surfaces
Enumerate services and identify potential vulnerabilities
Assess and categorise vulnerabilities using industry-standard frameworks
Perform basic penetration testing on networks and web applications
Document and report security findings in a professional format
author: Cyber Learn Team
